title: Sheehan-PoliticalComplexity: dated posterior tree set of D-PLACE societies
description:
A dated posterior tree set of D-PLACE societies, built from the global-language EDGE phylogeny (global-language-tree-pipeline v2.0.0). The EDGE trees are indexed by Glottolog codes. The pipeline grafts in 57 ancient, extinct, colonial and otherwise missing languages, retains the 982 languages that map to a D-PLACE society, expands each language tip into its societies, and dates society tips to their focal year. The final tree set is provided as grafted.trees.gz. The xml/ directory contains BEAST2 XML files for nested-sampling comparison of alternative models.

The build requires BEAST2 with the Babel package. TaxonReplacer and the multi-height TreeGrafter are available only in Babel git master (see build-babel.md). TaxonReplacer randomises internal node heights without a seed, so a rebuild reproduces the archived taxa and topology but not the exact branch lengths.
